outcome: Composition of child's fecal microbiota at 1 week, 1 month, and 1 year
Composition of child's airway microbiota at 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months
cohort: 665 mother-child dyads from the COPSAC(2010) cohort
finding: The study identified bacterial orders displaying patterns of persistent or transient transfer from the maternal vaginal microbiome to the child's gut and airway microbiota, as well as orders shared at later time points independent of delivery mode.
mod_finding: This study examined the impact of delivery mode on the transmission of maternal vaginal microbiota to the child's fecal and airway microbiota.
